title: Four players, keyboard player 1: stick camera, button names per player, leave glow, riftstone, Rift (DPC 0.9.172-dev38, Camera Distance 2.9.18-dev3)
intro: Player 1 on keyboard and mouse; the two PS5 controllers and the Xbox controller are players 2, 3 and 4, joining one at a time. All controllers awake (press a button on each now). A full party (three pawns), open ground, no enemies, playing the Arisen, co-op off. Every step waits for End (keyboard).

probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.cerrs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/CameraDistance.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.mode: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.cp and ((D.R.cp.on and D.R.cp.mode) or 'off')
probes.np: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.np_count and D.R.np_count() or 0
probes.who: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; if not D then return '' end; local t = {}; for _, p in ipairs(_G.DPC_API.players()) do t[#t + 1] = 'P' .. p.player .. ' ' .. tostring(p.info and p.info.name or (p.info and p.info.is_arisen and 'Arisen') or '?') .. (p.controller_lost and ' (lost)' or '') end; return table.concat(t, ' / ')
probes.nfr: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; if not D then return 0 end; local m = nil; for _, sl in pairs(D.R.np.slots) do if sl.active then m = math.min(m or 1e9, sl.frames or 0) end end; return m or 0
probes.nerr: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; if not D then return 0 end; local e = 0; for _, sl in pairs(D.R.np.slots) do e = e + (sl.errors or 0) + ((sl.in_err and 1) or 0) + ((sl.failed and 100) or 0) end; return e + ((D.R.np.err and 1000) or 0)
probes.lost: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; if not D then return 0 end; local n = 0; for _, sl in pairs(D.R.np.slots) do if sl.pad_lost then n = n + 1 end end; return n
probes.lway: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local L = D and D.R.lis; return L and (L.found or (L.failed and 'failed') or 'finding') or ''
probes.ai0: local p = H.pawn(0); local ok, v = pcall(function() return p:call('get_AIDecisionMaker'):call('get_DecisionModule'):call('get_IsSkipThink') end); return ok and v
probes.ai1: local p = H.pawn(1); local ok, v = pcall(function() return p:call('get_AIDecisionMaker'):call('get_DecisionModule'):call('get_IsSkipThink') end); return ok and v
probes.ai2: local p = H.pawn(2); local ok, v = pcall(function() return p:call('get_AIDecisionMaker'):call('get_DecisionModule'):call('get_IsSkipThink') end); return ok and v
probes.ptw: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local IN = package.loaded['PawnTacticalWheel.input']; if not IN then return 'not installed' end; return 'pad key ' .. tostring(IN.BINDS.pad_open_trig) .. (D and D.R.ptw.saved and ' (blocked by DPC)' or '')
probes.tgts: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; if not D then return '' end; local t = {}; for n, sl in pairs(D.R.np.slots) do t[#t + 1] = 'P' .. n .. ' ' .. (sl.tgt and 'target' or 'none') .. (sl.pin and ' (kept)' or '') end; table.sort(t); return table.concat(t, ' / ')
probes.kb: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.R.tp.p1 == D.R.KB_ADDR and 'player 1 on keyboard' or tostring(D.R.tp.p1)) or ''
probes.camn: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.cct and D.R.cct.n or 0
probes.rift: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (tostring(D.R.rift) .. ' ' .. tostring(D.R.rift_state)) or ''
probes.carry: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; if not D then return '' end; local t = {}; for n, sl in pairs(D.R.np.slots) do t[#t + 1] = 'P' .. n .. ' navi ' .. (sl.navi_stops or 0) .. ' cmd ' .. (sl.move_stops or 0) end; table.sort(t); return table.concat(t, ' / ')
probes.camenv: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.R.cam_env_n or 0) or 0
probes.camfrom: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; if not D then return '' end; local t = {}; for k, v in pairs(D.cfg.coop_cam_from or {}) do t[#t + 1] = k .. '=' .. tostring(v) end; table.sort(t); return table.concat(t, ' ')
probes.styles: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; if not D then return '' end; local R = D.R; local t = { 'P2 ' .. tostring(R.dev_style(R.tp.p2)) }; for n, sl in pairs(R.np.slots) do t[#t + 1] = 'P' .. n .. ' ' .. tostring(R.dev_style(sl.dev)) end; table.sort(t); return table.concat(t, ' / ')
probes.rimskip: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (tostring(D.R.int_rift_skips or 0) .. ' | ' .. tostring(D.R.int_name)) or ''

steps.text: Get ready (see the intro). Press End.
FIRST CONTROLLER (player 2): hold L3 + R3 until 'player 2 joined'. Co-op starts; player 1 stays on keyboard and mouse. End when done.
SECOND CONTROLLER (player 3): hold L3 + R3 until 'player 3 joined'. End when done.
THIRD CONTROLLER (player 4): hold L3 + R3 until 'player 4 joined'. She should be under player 4's control straight away (not walking off somewhere). End when done.
CAMERA: each controller gives its right stick a SLOW push: the camera should turn now (with player 1 on keyboard and mouse). Mouse still smooth? End when done.

expect.label: frames the camera was told 'stick, not mouse'

steps.text: BUTTON NAMES: each player's skill list shows their own controller's names (PS5 players Square / Triangle, the Xbox player X / Y) and doesn't flip when someone else presses a button. End when done.

CAMERA TICKS: REFramework menu > Direct Pawn Control > Couch co-op > 'Turns the camera': untick P3. It should stay unticked and player 3's stick stops turning the camera. Tick it again. End when done.

expect.label: left out of camera turning at some point (want p3=false)

steps.text: RIFTSTONE (if one is near): player 2 walks their pawn up to the riftstone: no '[Interact] Gather / Use' prompt now. Then player 1 can go into the Rift and back out: the camera should switch at once both ways. End when done (or straight away to skip).

expect.label: riftstones skipped | last object the prompt looked at

steps.text: LEAVING: PLAYER 4 holds L3 + R3 for 3 seconds: her pawn glows red as she leaves. Then PLAYER 3 the same. End when done.
PLAYER 1: press Ctrl + F6 to end co-op: player 2's pawn glows as they leave. End when done.
Done. Tell Claude: slow stick camera? Button names? Ticks? Riftstone prompt gone? Rift camera? Red glows (and is that the right red)?
